steps.summary: Signed in as admin on Grafana, opened the "Service health" dashboard via search. The dashboard contains 3 panels: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".

values.panel_titles: Request rate, Error count, Latency by endpoint

steps.summary: Created a new dashboard with a Stat panel titled "fwgr18-n2 Availability" using the TestData data source, and saved it as "fwgr18-n2 Bench Dashboard". The save drawer confirmed with a "Dashboard saved" alert, and the URL changed to /d/efwy5bfghnvggb/fwgr18-n2-bench-dashboard. Verified on the saved dashboard: panel heading "fwgr18-n2 Availability", visualization "Stat", and query row "A (TestData)" with the TestData logo.

Added a new Text panel to the dashboard "fwgr18-n2 Bench Dashboard" (UID efwy5bfghnvggb). Set the panel title to "fwgr18-n2 Notes" and the text content to "Notes for run fwgr18-n2". Clicked Save dashboard and confirmed the "Dashboard saved" alert. Both the panel title and content were verified on the live page after saving.

Replayed stored procedure s_5df8a8; observed panel_titles=Panel Title, fwgr18-n2 Availability, panel_1_title=fwgr18-n2 Notes, panel_2_title=fwgr18-n2 Notes, panel_1_text_content=Notes for run fwgr18-n2, panel_2_value=Notes for run fwgr18-n2.

Already on the edit panel page for the Text panel titled "fwgr18-n2 Notes". The title was already "fwgr18-n2 Notes" (no change needed). Clicked Save dashboard but the save drawer reported "No changes to save" since the title was already correct and the text content unchanged. Closed the drawer. The panel title remains "fwgr18-n2 Notes" as shown on the dashboard.

Opened dashboard settings, added the tag "bench" (confirmed visible in the tags list as a removable chip). Then set the dashboard's time range to "Last 6 hours" (already set, from=now-6h&to=now in the URL). Saved the dashboard explicitly via the Save drawer with "Update default time range" checked, confirmed by the "Dashboard saved" alert. Re-opened settings to verify: tag "bench" persists in the settings tags list.

Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to 1m via the refresh picker (previous attempt had already selected "1 minute" from the dropdown, visible as refresh=1m in the URL and "1m" in the picker). Then saved explicitly: opened the Save dashboard drawer, checked "Update default refresh value" (which registered the change as "Changes1"), and clicked Save — the "Dashboard saved" alert appeared. Verified after saving that the refresh picker still shows "1m" and the time range shows "Last 6 hours".

Reloaded the dashboard fresh and verified all six items from the live page: (1) dashboard title in the breadcrumb is "fwgr18-n2 Bench Dashboard"; (2) panels are "fwgr18-n2 Availability" (Stat, showing A-series value 9.22) and "fwgr18-n2 Notes" (Text, showing "Notes for run fwgr18-n2"); (3) time picker shows "Last 6 hours"; (4) refresh picker shows "1m" (button labelled "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"); (5) dashboard settings lists the tag "bench" (visible as a tag chip with remove button); (6) full URL is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efwy5bfghnvggb/fwgr18-n2-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m. Nothing was changed — I entered edit mode only to reach the Settings page to read tags, then exited edit mode without saving.

Entered edit mode for the "fwgr18-n2 Availability" panel. Confirmed that the data source selected in the query editor is TestData (shown as "TestData" in the query row). Confirmed the visualization type is Stat (shown in the visualization picker). No changes were made. Exited edit mode without saving.
